-- test: completion suggests pod names --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --pod ""
-- expect --
{{pod[0]}}
-- expect --
{{pod[1]}}


-- test: completion suggests deployment names --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --deployment ""
-- expect --
{{deployment}}


-- test: completion suggests logger names --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --pod {{pod}} logger ""
-- expect --
ROOT
-- expect --
com.example.testapp


-- test: completion suggests log levels --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --pod {{pod}} logger ROOT ""
-- expect --
DEBUG
-- expect --
TRACE
-- expect --
RESET


-- test: completion suggests raw endpoints --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --pod {{pod}} raw ""
-- expect --
health
-- expect --
loggers
-- expect --
metrics


-- test: completion suggests metric names --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --pod {{pod}} metrics ""
-- expect --
jvm.memory.used
-- expect --
process.uptime


-- test: completion suggests output formats not files --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete health -o ""
-- expect:stdout --
wide
-- expect:stdout --
json
-- expect:stdout --
yaml
-- expect:stdout --
:4


-- test: completion suggests thread states not files --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete threaddump --state ""
-- expect:stdout --
BLOCKED
-- expect:stdout --
RUNNABLE
-- expect:stdout --
:4


-- test: completion suggests env property names --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --pod {{pod}} env ""
-- expect:stdout --
spring.application.name
-- expect:stdout --
:4


-- test: completion suggests namespaces --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete --namespace ""
-- expect:stdout --
{{namespace}}
-- expect:stdout --
kube-system


-- test: completion of a no-args positional stays silent --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator __complete info ""
-- expect:stdout --
:4
